text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore Housing Development Board plans to build studio flats for senior citizens.
- Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore seizes tax documents from home and office of defeated Workers' Party candidate Tang Liang Hong for investigation.
- Tang Liang Hong says People's Action Party members suing him for defamation using unfair and unnecessary measures.
- Land Transport Authority says Road Pricing Scheme a success along East Coast Parkway during morning peak-hour period, so may be expanded.
- Another 25 initial public offers in the offing.
- Only 5.9 percent of applicants get part of Jade Technologies' initial public offering of four million shares.
- Singapore Telecom starts to cut handphone rates in direct challenge to new operator M1.
- Rafiq Jumabhoy has become substantial shareholder of Scotts Holdings with purchase of 12.95 million shares for Singapore $11 million.
- CITIC Pacific buys 20 percent stake in China Light and Power for Hong kong $16.25 billion.
- Malaysian stocks traded over-the-counter on Singapore's Clob International hit new highs on wave of speculative buying.
- Credit Lyonnais International Asset Management close to sale of unit to Nicholas-Applegate Capital Management.
- Land Transport Authority may release more Certificates of Entitlement to own vehicles as sweetener in package of measures to curb growing congestion in expressways.
- Straits Steamship Land gets Citibank NA as first anchor tenent in China Square Tower E.
- Businessman Soh Kim Yong buys 8.97 percent stake in Heshe Holdings.
